name: Maria
summary: Complete internet outage affecting all users on the 5th floor, preventing email and file access.
suggested_reply: Thank you for reporting this. We're treating this as a high priority. Can you confirm if the issue is affecting all devices on the 5th floor, or specific ones? We're investigating the network infrastructure now and will update you shortly.

name: Lena

name: David
summary: User's second monitor is flickering intermittently.

summary: User requests Adobe Acrobat installation for PDF editing purposes.

name: Sarah
summary: 3rd floor printer is producing faded output quality.

name: Tom
summary: User needs help configuring an out-of-office auto-reply in Outlook before vacation.
